name: DueDiligenceFindingsTracker
tagline: DD request lists, findings, red flags and the DD report – in one Power Platform app.
description: A complete legal due diligence module for Canvas apps, Model-driven apps and Power Pages: request list with follow-ups and data room references, review, findings with risk rating, exposure, materiality and red flags, remedies with SPA references, partner sign-off and DD report gates with a red-flag summary by workstream.
features: Follow-ups with limit and chase lists
Risk rating, exposure, materiality and red-flag thresholds
Five report gates and one-click Issue report
Heat map, 14 scopes, grouping, filters, bulk actions, undo, CSV export
